bio: I'm a junior at Tufts studying Computer Science, with minors in Finance and AI Development. I like markets and systems for the same reason, they're built on logic that isn't always obvious, and figuring out why something counterintuitive works is where I learn the most. That's the lens I bring to research, startups, and building things people actually use. Outside of that, I write for the Tufts Daily, compete with the Tufts Ballroom Club, and almost always have a book going.
